scientific_integrity: All universal statements are supplied with an analytic proof. Finite numerical assertions are supplementary, not infinite certificates. Noncommuting mixed degrees are distinguished from the prior self-commutator result.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to standard weighted harmonic Bergman disk and distinct positive monomial degrees; no arbitrary symbol or exact-kernel classification. Full publication priority and independent mathematical verification are not established.
title: Paired mixed commutator spectra and sharp weak-Schatten law on weighted harmonic Bergman spaces
